title: WhatsApp Pay user cap doubled to 40 mn
description: NPCI allowed WhatsApp to extend UPI payments from 20 mn to 40 mn registered users in India.

title: UPI123Pay launched for feature phones
description: RBI and NPCI launched UPI123Pay, enabling UPI payments on feature phones without internet access.

title: WhatsApp Pay user cap raised to 100 mn
description: NPCI permitted WhatsApp to onboard up to 100 mn UPI users, up from 40 mn.

title: UPI Lite launched
description: NPCI launched UPI Lite at Global Fintech Fest 2022 — an on-device wallet for small-value payments without PIN entry.

title: RuPay credit cards go live on UPI
description: Credit-on-UPI launched: RuPay credit cards could be linked to UPI, adding a credit-funded payment rail that lifts average ticket size.

title: NPCI extends 30% market-cap deadline to Dec 2024
description: NPCI pushed the deadline for the 30% volume-cap compliance for existing third-party apps (PhonePe, Google Pay) from Dec 2022 to Dec 31, 2024.

title: PhonePe completes separation from Flipkart
description: PhonePe fully separated from the Flipkart group and shifted domicile to India ahead of a major fundraise.

title: UPI opened to NRIs on international numbers
description: NPCI allowed NRE/NRO account holders in ten countries to transact on UPI using international mobile numbers.

title: UPI–PayNow cross-border link launched
description: India and Singapore linked UPI and PayNow, enabling real-time cross-border remittances between the two systems.

title: 1.1% interchange on PPI-wallet UPI merchant payments
description: NPCI introduced a 1.1% interchange fee on merchant UPI payments above ₹2,000 funded via prepaid wallets, while keeping bank-account UPI free.

title: Pre-sanctioned credit lines enabled on UPI
description: RBI allowed banks to offer pre-sanctioned credit lines through UPI, expanding UPI beyond deposit accounts into credit.

title: UPI limit raised to ₹5 lakh for hospitals and education
description: RBI raised the per-transaction UPI limit from ₹1 lakh to ₹5 lakh for payments to hospitals and educational institutions, lifting high-ticket use cases.

title: RBI bars Paytm Payments Bank
description: RBI ordered Paytm Payments Bank to stop accepting deposits and credits, forcing Paytm to migrate its UPI handles to partner banks and triggering a sustained share decline.

title: UPI goes live in France
description: UPI payments went live at the Eiffel Tower via the Lyra partnership — the first UPI merchant acceptance in Europe.

title: Paytm approved as TPAP with four partner banks
description: NPCI approved One97 (Paytm) to operate UPI as a third-party app via Axis, HDFC, SBI and Yes Bank, completing its migration off Paytm Payments Bank.

title: UPI Circle (delegated payments) launched
description: NPCI launched UPI Circle, letting a primary user delegate full or partial payment authority to trusted secondary users on one bank account.

title: 30% market-cap deadline extended to Dec 2026
description: NPCI extended the compliance deadline for the 30% UPI volume cap for existing third-party apps by two more years, to Dec 31, 2026.

title: WhatsApp Pay user cap removed
description: NPCI removed the onboarding cap on WhatsApp Pay entirely, allowing it to extend UPI to its full Indian user base.

title: ₹1,500 cr incentive scheme for low-value P2M UPI
description: The Union Cabinet approved an incentive scheme compensating banks for small-value person-to-merchant UPI transactions under the zero-MDR regime for FY 2024-25.

title: NPCI API usage caps take effect
description: NPCI limits on non-customer-initiated API calls (balance checks, autopay mandate timing, transaction status checks) took effect to protect UPI infrastructure stability.
